the element name: u32 byte length then the raw characters, no NUL.
kind = table index of the name. ECX is the character pointer at [ESP+34h], or the empty literal 00E19BF4 when that pointer is null (0072739e).
u32 element index into EAX, read immediately after the name.

push_back of the 2Ch-byte temporary at [ESP+4ch]. Contract inferred from the call site; body unread, but 00727277/0072727e's 0x2E8BA2E9 / SAR EDX,3 is division by 0x2C per docs/PART_DAMAGE_REACHABILITY.md.
the temporary's teardown frees [ESP+6ch] = element+20h when nonzero.
and [ESP+70h] = element+24h.
and [ESP+60h] = element+14h, the ordinal vector's storage.
u32 vertexCount into EDI.
reserve on mesh+18h (0072747c ADD EBX,18h). Contract inferred from the call site; body unread.
vertex x, FSTP [ESP+40h].

u32 triangleCount, saved to [ESP+18h] at 007274fd.
per element, reserve element[i]+10h with triangleCount / elementCount (00727503 CDQ / 00727504 IDIV [ESP+88h]). Contract inferred from the call site; body unread.
reserve on mesh+28h with triangleCount. Contract inferred from the call site; body unread.
append a zeroed 6-byte record to mesh+28h; 007275ab LEA EAX,[EDI-6] confirms the 6-byte stride. Contract inferred from the call site; body unread.
the triangle's element index, into [ESP+1ch]; bounds-checked against the element vector at 007275e6..00727612.

the grow path of the ordinal append when the fast path at 00727643 has no capacity. Contract inferred from the call site; body unread.

triangle corner 0, into [ESP+24h]; stored as a word at 007276d4.
triangle corner 1, into [ESP+28h]; ECX comes from the previous call's EAX, which 00be9a97 sets to the node handle.
triangle corner 2, into [ESP+2ch]; stored as a word at 007276e5.
first trailing value, into the scratch slot [ESP+14h]: discarded.
second trailing value, into the same slot: discarded.
third trailing value, into the same slot: discarded.
the merge pass's grow path when appending a merged element's ordinals.
a finalizer on the mesh, called once after the merge pass. Body unread; named by address only.

corrections.subject: docs/PART_DAMAGE_REACHABILITY.md section 1e, the helper legend and the n2 block
corrections.was: `00BE9A80 a u16` and `007274c4 u32 n2 ; repeat n2: two u16 reads (00be9a80 x2)`.
corrections.is: 00BE9A80 reads a DWORD. Its body calls 00BF0280, the same primitive 00BE9A00 (BSP_StructuredNode_ReadU32) and 00BE99E0 call, already recorded in the ledger as BSP_StreamReader_ReadDwordSlot34AndDebit; 00be9a95 stores a dword through the out-parameter. The pair block is therefore two u32 per entry, eight bytes, and every triangle read through 00BE9A80 is four bytes wide.
corrections.evidence: 00be9a80's disassembly and bytes (8b 01 ... e8 ... c2 04 00), 00bf0280's existing ledger record, and the decode: with 00BE9A80 at four bytes Farragut_1934.MMOD's chunk at 0x1587DF consumes exactly its declared 0x1C5BA payload with zero leftover; at two bytes it stops 70104 bytes short and produces nonsense triangles ((829,0,829,0), (0,830,0,826)).

corrections.was: `models/ships/us/Farragut_1934.MMOD`, `GeomMesh` chunk at file offset `0x1587E3` (`08 00 00 00 "GeomMesh"` counted tag ...)
corrections.is: 0x1587E3 is where the eight characters `GeomMesh` begin. The counted tag, that is the `08 00 00 00` length prefix the reader consumes first, starts at 0x1587DF; the u32 payload size 0x1C5BA is at 0x1587EB and the payload body at 0x1587EF.
corrections.evidence: hexdump of 0x1587D0..0x15782F of this installation's file; the host StructuredReader reads a root at 0x1587DF and reports tag GeomMesh with declared_payload 0x1C5BA.

host_interface_limit.issue: StructuredResourceParser::decode writes into StructuredResourcePayload, a closed std::variant of MeshResourcePayload / NoteResourcePayload / GroupParamsResourcePayload declared in include/bsp/structured_resource_registry.hpp, which this packet does not own and did not edit.
host_interface_limit.resolution: GeomMeshStructuredResourceParser derives from the base and registers normally; its decode leaves the variant argument untouched and delivers the payload through a caller-supplied sink and last_payload(). Deriving needed no change to the peer's header. Adding a fourth alternative to the variant is the coordination change that would remove the seam, and it belongs to the registry's owner.
